name: Lyssna
description:
Lyssna's MCP server connects your research data directly to Claude, so you can ask about your  studies and get an answer grounded in what participants actually said – not a guess.

Built for researchers, designers, product managers and marketers – whether you're checking if something's already been tested or pulling evidence for your next stakeholder conversation.

What you can do:

- Ask questions about a single study, or across multiple usability tests, survey, and interviews you have access to, and get answers pulled from actual study data, not the model's best guess
- Access test details, study structure, recruitment info, screener answers, responses, recordings, and test recording transcripts
- Compare results across studies instead of reopening each one to find what you need
- Bring findings straight into your workflow – a PRD, a design rationale, a campaign brief, a stakeholder update
- Combine Lyssna's research data with your other connected tools – for example, pulling quotes from a study straight into a Linear ticket or a Notion doc

This is a read-only connector: it retrieves your Lyssna research data – usability tests, surveys, and test recording transcripts – but never creates or modifies anything there. Access follows your existing Lyssna permissions, so you'll only see what you already have access to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lyssna to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lyssna to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.lyssna.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lyssna MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lyssna provides these MCP tools: describe_data, get_data, and search_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lyssna?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lyssna in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Lyssna requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lyssna is developed by Lyssna. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
